meta.title: Audemars Piguet | Haute Horlogerie Experiences
meta.description: Discover Audemars Piguet's immersive masterclasses and plunge into the heart of the Manufacture's craftsmanship through unique watchmaking experiences.

sections.module: ap-primary-hero (theme-dark, cell large-5 offset-7 — title right)
sections.text: Immerse yourself into the world of Audemars Piguet with a series of masterclasses, offering a unique insight into the Manufacture's craftsmanship.

Discover the fascinating universe of Haute Horlogerie through hands‑on experiences that reveal the expertise Audemars Piguet has honed for generations. Register for an upcoming masterclass and enjoy an immersive watchmaking experience.

Decode the secrets of Haute Horlogerie and step into the world of Audemars Piguet by joining one of our masterclasses. You will have the rare opportunity to experience our craft firsthand by practising decorative techniques and assembling components from our collections.
Book your place now for one of our upcoming watchmaking experiences.

sections.text: Browse our selection of masterclasses and choose the experience that suits you best. Two levels are currently available — Newbie and Timekeeper — with more to come soon. Each offers an experience-based introduction to the world of Haute Horlogerie and to the Manufacture's uncompromising craftsmanship.
